messages.subject: Project Sable - draft completion statement
messages.plaintextBody:
Isla, Rebecca,

Draft completion statement attached for the 21 November completion. The balance due to the seller is £21,979,160.24 (after credit for the deposit and net apportionments). Separately, SDLT of £1,227,000 will be payable within 14 days of completion and total acquisition costs are c.£1,553,790.

The figures include the credit for the September quarter's rent received in advance, the service charge on account, the Northbridge rent deposit (£121,500) and the £20,000 service charge retention. Please let us know the completion funds will be in place.

Best,
Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP

---
This email and any attachments are confidential and may be legally privileged.
